[[File:Coelan.png|alt=Two twinned red roses on a back of horizontal blue and white stripes|thumb|Sign of House Coelan]]'''House Coelan''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. Lord [[Pelivar Coelan]] is the [[High Seat]] of House Coelan.

==Sigil==
The sigil of House Coelan consists of two red roses, side by side, on a field of horizontal blue and white stripes.{{ref/book|twotc}}

==Activities==
During the Third Succession War, House Coelan supported [[House Trakand]] gaining the throne.

House Coelan was among the three great Houses that met with the [[Amyrlin Seat]] [[Egwene]] in [[Murandy]]{{ref/book|8|17}}.

During the [[Fourth Succession War]], House Coelan was initially among the six neutral great Houses that stayed apart during the Siege of Caemlyn.

After the Siege of Caemlyn House Coelan supported [[Elayne Trakand]] due to [[Dyelin Taravin]]'s speech in her favour{{ref/book|11|35}}.
